Mismatch repair status and clinical outcome in endometrial cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis. BACKGROUND The association between the deficiency in mismatch repair (MMR) genes and prognosis in women with endometrial cancer is unclear. Here we report a systematic review and meta-analysis exploring this association. METHODS We searched literature databases (MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Cochrane) from 1980 until December 2011 to identify studies evaluating the association between MMR status and clinical outcome in endometrial cancer. The main outcome measures were overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS). RESULTS Twenty-three studies met the inclusion criteria.
